title: Preserve all six HTML heading levels as text blocks
problem: Make PageText preserve separate text blocks for all six HTML heading levels. Keep existing parser behavior intact.
acceptance_criteria: Treat every heading level h1 through h6 as a block boundary: visible text before, inside, and after a heading is separated by newlines, including adjacent headings.
Preserve hidden/aria-hidden suppression, visible br formatting, character references, title and link extraction; do not change network fetching, URL policy, or unrelated parser behavior.
Add concise standard-library unittest tests using synthetic HTML in the new test file. No dependency changes, live requests, or existing-test edits.
